passage: At the school gate in Bhopal, Pankaj's classmate Uma said, “Come on, everyone does it. Just skip the quiz. You have to decide right now!” Pankaj felt his stomach tighten. He asked, “What's the reason?” Uma shrugged. “Because it's fun.” Pankaj said, “Let me think about it.” He walked away and found Ms. Nair, the counsellor. He told her that Uma was pressing him to hide from the quiz, and that she also had asked him to keep it secret. Ms. Nair thanked him. “Taking time and telling me was the right thing.” Pankaj felt his shoulders drop.

qa.q: Who did Pankaj tell about the pressure?
What was Pankaj feeling when Uma said everyone does it, and how do you know?
qa.a: He felt pressured and uneasy, since his stomach tightened, and he asked for a reason and time to think.
Asking what the reason was, taking time to think and telling a trusted adult about the pressure and the secret.

qa.q: How might Uma see Pankaj's walking away?
qa.a: She may feel annoyed that he did not go along, or she may not have thought it through, since her only reason was that it was fun.

grounding: A child notices everyone does it and pressure to decide quickly, asks what the reason is, takes time and tells a trusted adult.

passage: From the back of the classroom I saw Sabina talk to Karthik at the desk. “Everyone in Class 7 is doing it,” she said. “You have to decide by the bell, or you'll miss out.” Karthik looked at his shoes, then said, “Why?” Sabina said, “Because everyone is.” He didn't answer for a bit. “I want to think,” he said. Sabina said, “You'll regret it!” Karthik took his bag and walked to the teacher's desk. I couldn't hear what he said, but he looked calmer afterwards. I don't know what she wanted, but his questions seemed sensible.

qa.q: Who did Karthik go to after Sabina's talk?
qa.a: The teacher, at the teacher's desk.

qa.q: What was Karthik probably feeling when Sabina told him to decide by the bell?
qa.a: He probably felt pressured and unsure, so he asked why and said he wanted to think.

qa.q: What habit did Karthik show that others can copy?
qa.a: He asked for the reason, took time to think and went to a trusted adult.

qa.q: How might Sabina see Karthik's decision to walk away?
qa.a: She may feel frustrated or worried he would miss out, though the observer cannot know what she wanted.

grounding: A child notices the everyone does it appeal and pressure to decide quickly, asks the reason, takes time and goes to a trusted adult, seen by an observer.
